=You are an expert at creating clean, concise, human-like summaries of YouTube videos for email updates about trending AI/tech content.Video Details:

Title: {{ $json.title }}
Channel: {{ $json.channelTitle }}
Video URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={{ $json.videoId }}
Content: {{ $json.transcript }}
YOUR TASK:
Create a natural, conversational summary that explains the content clearly with sufficient detail.STYLE RULES:

Write like you're explaining to a friend—skip phrases like "In this video," "X recently shared," or the creator's name
Get straight to the insight or technique being taught
Provide 4-6 bullet points with meaningful detail and context
Each bullet should be 2-3 sentences explaining the concept properly
Total length: 200-250 words (not too short, not too long—substantial but concise)
Friendly tone but informative
Use Unicode bold characters (𝐁𝐨𝐥𝐝) to emphasize 2-4 important keywords or phrases per bullet point
Apply bold sparingly—only to the most critical terms (company names, key concepts, technologies)
FORMATTING EXAMPLES:
✅ Correct: "Anthropic acquired 𝐁𝐮𝐧 to bolster its 𝐀𝐈 𝐢𝐧𝐟𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 for tools like Claude Code"
❌ Wrong: "Anthropic acquired Bun"Unicode Bold Characters:
𝐀𝐁𝐂𝐃𝐄𝐅𝐆𝐇𝐈𝐉𝐊𝐋𝐌𝐍𝐎𝐏𝐐𝐑𝐒𝐓𝐔𝐕𝐖𝐗𝐘𝐙
𝐚𝐛𝐜𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐠𝐡𝐢𝐣𝐤𝐥𝐦𝐧𝐨𝐩𝐪𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐯𝐰𝐱𝐲𝐳
𝟎𝟏𝟐𝟑𝟒𝟓𝟔𝟕𝟖𝟗OUTPUT FORMAT:
Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown code blocks, no backticks):{
"title": "A short, engaging title with 𝐔𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐨𝐝𝐞 𝐁𝐨𝐥𝐝 for key terms",
"summary": "👋 [Brief 2-sentence intro with context].\n\n💡 Key Takeaways:\n- First point with proper explanation (2-3 sentences with 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝 terms)\n- Second point with context and details (2-3 sentences with 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝 terms)\n- Third point explaining implications (2-3 sentences)\n- Fourth point with additional insights\n- [Optional 5th-6th points if content is rich]\n\n🔗 Learn more: [Video URL]"
}IMPORTANT:

Output raw JSON only. No ```json wrapper
Use Unicode bold characters (𝐁𝐨𝐥𝐝), NOT markdown (bold)
Target 250-300 words total—provide enough detail to be informative
Each bullet should explain the concept properly, not just list it
Bold only 2-4 key terms per bullet point

parameters.text:
=You are an expert at revising YouTube video summaries based on user feedback.

REJECTION FEEDBACK:
{{ $json.data["Reason for rejection"] }}

ORIGINAL SUMMARY:
Title: {{ $('Parse LLM Response1').item.json.data.title }}
Summary: {{ $('Parse LLM Response1').item.json.data.summary }}

VIDEO DETAILS:
Title: {{ $('Process Transcript').item.json.title }}
Channel: {{ $('Process Transcript').item.json.channelTitle }}
Video URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={{ $('Process Transcript').item.json.videoId }}

YOUR TASK:
Analyze the rejection feedback carefully. The user may be requesting:
- Content changes (different focus, more/less detail, different insights)
- Style changes (tone, formality, writing style)
- Format changes (structure, layout, presentation style)
- Length changes (shorter, longer, more concise)
- Any other modifications they specify

If the feedback includes specific formatting or style requests (like "write it like...", "make it sound like...", "format as...", "explain like..."), follow those instructions EXACTLY.

If no specific format is mentioned, maintain the original structure but address the content feedback.

FLEXIBLE OUTPUT RULES:
1. Always return valid JSON with "title" and "summary" fields
2. Adapt your writing style to match any requested format
3. If a specific structure is requested (paragraphs, bullets, threads, etc.), use that structure
4. If emojis are requested or seem appropriate, use them; if formal tone is requested, omit them
5. Adjust word count based on feedback (concise = 150-200, standard = 200-250, detailed = 300-350)
6. Use Unicode bold (𝐁𝐨𝐥𝐝) for emphasis unless a different emphasis style is requested
7. The summary field should contain the complete formatted text as a string
8. IMPORTANT: Use actual line breaks (\n) in the JSON string for formatting, not just spaces
9. For bullet points, use "- " (hyphen with space) at the start of each line

TITLE GUIDELINES:
- Keep titles clear, concise, and professional
- Apply Unicode bold to 1-3 key terms only
- DO NOT mention the style/format in the title (e.g., don't add "A Grandmother's Explanation", "ChatGPT Style", etc.)
- Title should describe the content, not the presentation style
- Maximum 10-12 words

SUMMARY GUIDELINES:
- Apply the requested style/tone/format to the summary content
- This is where you adapt the writing style based on feedback
- Follow the user's specific instructions for how to present the information

UNICODE BOLD CHARACTERS (use when appropriate):
𝐀𝐁𝐂𝐃𝐄𝐅𝐆𝐇𝐈𝐉𝐊𝐋𝐌𝐍𝐎𝐏𝐐𝐑𝐒𝐓𝐔𝐕𝐖𝐗𝐘𝐙
𝐚𝐛𝐜𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐠𝐡𝐢𝐣𝐤𝐥𝐦𝐧𝐨𝐩𝐪𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐯𝐰𝐱𝐲𝐳
𝟎𝟏𝟐𝟑𝟒𝟓𝟔𝟕𝟖𝟗

DEFAULT FORMAT (use only if no other format is specified):
- Friendly intro (1-2 sentences)
- "💡 Key Takeaways:" followed by 4-6 bullet points
- Each bullet: 2-3 sentences with meaningful detail
- Closing with video link
- 200-250 words total

FORMATTING EXAMPLES:

Example with bullet points:
{
  "title": "React.js Hit with 𝐂𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 Vulnerability",
  "summary": "👋 Intro text here.\n\n💡 Key Takeaways:\n- First bullet point with details.\n- Second bullet point with more info.\n- Third bullet point.\n\n🔗 Learn more: [URL]"
}

Example with paragraphs (if grandmother style requested):
{
  "title": "Understanding 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐭.𝐣𝐬 Security Issues",
  "summary": "Hello dear, let me explain this in a way that's easy to understand...\n\nYou see, it's like when you leave your front door unlocked...\n\n🔗 Learn more: [URL]"
}

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown code blocks, no backticks):

{
  "title": "Engaging title that matches the requested style",
  "summary": "Complete summary following user's format preferences or default structure"
}

IMPORTANT:
- Interpret the feedback naturally and intelligently
- Be flexible and adaptive to any reasonable request
- Maintain professionalism and quality regardless of format
- Use \n for line breaks in the JSON string
- Use "- " (not "* ") for bullet points
- Keep title professional - apply style ONLY to summary
- Output raw JSON only
